scope: Actual named release EXE/PCK; engine one-second FPS observations include cold startup and output logging. Not a frame-present trace, input-latency measurement, GPU timer, or sustained casting certification. Twelve finite slot-1 attempts use ordinary cooldown/Flux rules; refusals and idle after sequence/expiry remain in the sample. No resource refill, app closure, or current-source engine is used. Requested --quit-after iterations are not seconds or verified displayed-frame counts. Win32 foreground ownership and main-window visibility/minimization are sampled roughly every500ms after process launch; unavailable handles are null, not proof of a hidden window. Visibility does not prove unobscured presentation.
